About

At December Salon & Spa, clients experience a blend of sophistication and style in their pursuit of beautiful hair. Specializing in tape hair extensions, the team ensures a seamless installation and maintenance process tailored to individual needs. Each visit promises expert care, transforming your look while prioritizing the health and integrity of your natural hair.
